McCain finished Sunday's 123-113 loss to the Heat with 20 points (7-17 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 4-5 FT), two rebounds and three assists in 29 minutes.
news.story: McCain has averaged 18.2 points in 30.6 minutes per tilt over his last five games, benefiting from Oklahoma City's depleted backcourt. He's made 17 triples during that stretch, strengthening his fantasy appeal. However, limited assists and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's (back/neck) eventual return could reduce the former's opportunities.

news.headline: McCain logged 18 points (7-14 FG, 3-9 3Pt, 1-2 FT), three rebounds, one block and one steal in 30 minutes during Friday's 126-120 win over New Orleans.
news.story: McCain gave the Thunder steady scoring for a second straight night and made the defensive play of the game. He blocked a Jeremiah Fears layup in the final half-minute and grabbed the last rebound to seal it. The third-year guard has settled into a starting role while Oklahoma City deals with a long list of injuries. He's averaging 13.7 points and has been one of the team's more dependable scorers.

This was Burries' first game with the second unit since Oct. 31, as Ryan Rollins moved back into the starting five, but the duo saw nearly equal workloads. Coach Taylor Jenkins might continue to mix and match next to Herro in his backcourt as he searches for a lineup that clicks.

news.story: Harden couldn't be stopped Friday, as he scored a game- and season-high 51 points to lead Cleveland to a 14-point comeback win. Per NBA.com, the 37-year-old passed Kobe Bryant for the third-most 50-point games on the NBA's all-time list.

news.story: The 26 points were a career high for the rookie guard, but Burries' big afternoon got overshadowed by Tyler Herro's career-high 50.
